newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrican police arrest Australia paedophile suspect.
newsitem.headline: SAfrican police arrest Australia paedophile suspect.

text.p: South African police said on Friday they had arrested an Australian paedophile suspect wanted in his country in connection with about 200 charges of child sexual abuse.
"Phillip Bell, 62, was arrested on Friday morning on about 200 charges of indecent molestation of children," police spokeswoman Sergeant Marianette Olivier said.
She said Bell had been on the run from Interpol and had apparently tried to settle in the popular Eastern Cape surfing resort of Jeffrey's Bay.
The suspect appeared in court briefly after his arrest, but no evidence was heard and the case was remanded to Monday for an extradition application, Olivier said.
